parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.part_stem:
An object is projected horizontally at a speed of $6.0\text{ m s}^{-1}$ from a slope, as shown in Fig. 2.1.

{{figure:figure_2_1}}

The slope is at an angle $\theta$ to the horizontal. Air resistance is negligible.

The object lands on the slope a time of $0.71\text{ s}$ later and stops without rolling or bouncing.
parts.text: Determine the horizontal distance travelled by the object.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Determine the vertical distance travelled by the object.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Use your answers in (b)(i) and (b)(ii) to calculate $\theta$.

parts.label: (b)(iv)
parts.text: Determine the magnitude of the displacement of the object from its original position.

parts.label: (b)(v)
parts.text: By considering energy, calculate the speed of the object just before it lands.
